description: Read-only search of the US, EU and Israeli trademark registers through Open Trademarks (opentrademarks.org): the registered marks that share a query's spelling or sound, ranked, each with its register, number, state, classes and how it matched. Nothing is filed or changed. Optional `registers` (a subset of `us`, `eu`, `il`) and `limit` (1 to 100). A search lists marks; it does not clear a name, and an empty list is not clearance. For a verdict on one name use `check_trademark`. `registers_read` gives each register's read date, and a register with no `loaded_at` was not searched. Never tell a user a name is clear from this tool. Quote `notice` as written when the answer carries one: a register search is not legal advice.

limit.description: Optional: how many marks to return, 1 to 100.

query.description: The words to look for in registered marks (e.g. 'koh').

registers.description: Which registers to read: a subset of `us`, `eu` and `il`. All three when left out.

name: search_trademarks

outputSchema.description: The Open Trademarks `/v1/search` answer, as the API sent it.

generated_at.description: When Open Trademarks built this answer.
generated_at.title: Generated At

marks.description: Marks that share the query's spelling or sound, ranked. A search lists marks; it does not clear a name.

class_overlap.description: The classes it shares with the classes checked.
class_overlap.title: Class Overlap

classes.description: The Nice classes the mark covers.
classes.title: Classes

mark.description: The mark's words as registered. Null for a mark with none.
mark.title: Mark

office_url.description: The mark's page on the register's own site.
office_url.title: Office Url

reg_number.description: The registration number, when it has one.
reg_number.title: Reg Number

register.description: Which register holds the mark: `us`, `eu` or `il`.
register.title: Register

signals.description: How it matched, each signal reported separately (for example `exact`, `variant`, `sound`, `spelling`, `contains`). Never one score.
signals.title: Signals

state.description: `live` or `dead`, as the register reports it.
state.title: State

marks.title: Marks

notice.description: The answer's own caveat, when it carries one. Quote it as written.
notice.title: Notice

registers_read.description: Every register searched with its read date.
